verdict.rationale: First-party docs and the GitHub README consistently state that Firecrawl returns scraped content as structured JSON. The scrape endpoint accepts a `json` format with a prompt and schema (docs-16), the README shows schema-based structured extraction (gh-7, gh-9), and parsed files can also come back as structured JSON (docs-6). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the JSON extraction works reliably in practice.
